p: all ye people: Because of the malice and obstinacy of the people, whom he had so often exhorted to repentance, he summons them to God's judgments, taking all creatures, and God himself as witness, that the preaching of the Prophets, which they have abused, will be avenged.
down: Meaning by this that God will come to judgment against the strong cities and strongholds.

Samaria: Samaria, which should have been an example to all Israel of true religion and justice, was the dirty pool and the tank that all idolatry and corruption was kept alive in, and who prided themselves in their father Jacob, and boasted of him.
places of Judah: That is, the idolatry and infection.
hires thereof shall be burned with: Which they gathered by evil practices, and thought that their idols had enriched them with these wages because of their service to them.
to the hire of an harlot: The gain that came by their idols will be consumed as a thing of nothing: for as the wages or riches of harlots are wickedly gotten, so are they vilely and quickly spent.
Gath: Lest the Philistines our enemies rejoice at our destruction.

Aphrah roll thyself in the dust: Which was a city near to Jerusalem Jos 18:23, there called Ophrah, and signifies dust: therefore he wants them to mourn and roll themselves in the dust, for their dusty city.
Saphir: These were cities by which the enemy would pass as he came to Judah.
receive of you his standing: He will not depart before he has overcome you, and so you will pay for his staying.
gate of Jerusalem: For Rabshakeh had shut up Jerusalem, so that they could not send to help them.
swift beast: To flee away: for Sennacherib laid siege first to that city, and remained there when he sent his captains and army against Jerusalem.
is the beginning of the sin: You first received the idolatry of Jeroboam, and so infected Jerusalem.
Moreshethgath: You will bribe the Philistines your neighbours, but they will deceive you, as well as those of Jerusalem.
heir unto thee: He prophesies against his own city: and because it signified a heritage, he says that God would send an heir to possess it.
the glory of Israel: For so they thought themselves because of the strength of their cities.
